title: Chapter 1036
text:
Facing Han Xiao's teasing, Secret Master's expression darkened. He did not bother to reply. His gaze went past Han Xiao and looked at the stream of light at the edge of the battlefield.

Very soon, the exposed Mech Legion sent out a portion of their people to escort the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy out of sight.

The cooked duck had flown away. His mood fell from the peak to the bottom. He was not in a good mood.

He intended to chase, but Black Star's Lord's Avatar was in front of him, emitting a high-intensity energy wave that made him subconsciously tense. Once he moved, he would definitely attract a storm of attacks.

Secret Master retracted his gaze and locked onto Han Xiao in front of him again. He sized him up carefully and said with a tone that was seventy percent dissatisfied and thirty percent interested.

"Black Star, this should be the second time we've met, right?"

"Counting the Meeting of the Gods, it is indeed the second time." Han Xiao nodded.

"Humph, then we're pretty … fated!" Secret Master could not help but emphasize his tone.

He was furious that the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was taken away, but they were all here to snatch it. Everything depended on strength. Whoever snatched it would get it, so there was nothing to question.

He originally wanted to be the oriole behind the mantis stalking the cicada, but he did not expect Han Xiao to be there too. Furthermore, he hid even deeper. In the end, he was robbed, and all his efforts were for naught.

He really wanted the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. Now that it was taken away by Black Star, it was not to the point of making him an enemy. They were all big shots in the universe. It was fine if he could not take it away, but if he completely fell out because of this, it would not look good, so there was no need for that.

However, it was impossible for him to retreat just like that. He had to fight back. Secret Master did not plan to watch Han Xiao escape so easily. That would make him look like he was scared away by Black Star. He was a person who cared about his reputation, unlike the seven-eyed guy next to him who was used to it.

He secretly tried his teleportation spell and realized that it was restricted by the Void Prison.

After I break this domain, I'll still have a chance to catch up to the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and take it back …

Secret Master adjusted his mentality and focused on dealing with the current situation. He suppressed his anger, regained his cold expression, and started chatting.

"Speaking of which, I've always been curious about you. Although we haven't had much contact before, I have a deep impression of you."

"How deep?" Han Xiao didn't mind bickering with him for a while to stall for time.

"Everyone in the universe is talking about your deeds. In my eyes, you are an ambitious schemer, but at the same time, you are an opportunist. Luck played a large part in the fact that you were able to lay your foundation. Every time you speculated, it gave you the opportunity to develop quickly. You are a lucky person."

Hearing this, Han Xiao could not help but look at Secret Master a few more times.

This is the first time someone said that I'm lucky. You must have mistaken me for someone else …

He could understand why Secret Master had such an impression of him. In the eyes of the outside world, his rise to power was extremely swift and smooth. All the opportunities seemed to be due to luck.

However, this "luck" was actually an opportunity created by him because he was familiar with the direction of the world and had an advantage in information.

However, outsiders would never know this.

"Let's just say that I'm lucky," Han Xiao joked.

"Heh, but from today onwards, your good luck ends." Magic runes appeared in the depths of Secret Master's eyes. "You should have heard of my name. I can control a person's luck."

Looking at how confident he was, Han Xiaoxin felt a little strange and had no choice but to play along.

"You want to weaken my luck for a long time?"

"You stole my things. You have to pay a price."

Secret Master snorted.

In fact, he was not willing to become enemies with Han Xiao. After all, after the Meeting of the Gods, Han Xiao's position in the Beyond Grade A circle was rather special. As a neutral party, it was best not to provoke him.

However, he could not take this lying down, and he had to give Han Xiao an explanation. Therefore, he decided to use his best move to punish Han Xiao.

Sure enough, we still have to talk with our fists … Han Xiao had expected this and never thought that the other party would give up.

The next moment, Secret Master's body emitted a dazzling blue magic light.

"Everyone says that you are very good at fighting. Let me experience it for myself and see how strong you are."

As soon as his voice fell, the accumulated magic energy gushed out like a tsunami, exploding brazenly.

Rumble!

Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar was blasted away by the burst of magic energy.

Secret Master took the opportunity to retreat, trying to increase the distance between them. However, after being strengthened by the God's Trait Transformation, the effect of the Void Prison had increased. This domain-type ability did not differentiate between friend and foe. Han Xiao, who had the Void talent, could move freely within it.

He soon realized that no matter how he retreated, he could not get away from Han Xiao. Seeing this, he decided to stop moving and turned into a magic cannon, starting to cast spells.

In order to snatch the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, the Lord's Avatar had used Void Displacement to switch positions with the sealed container, causing it to leave the Mech Legion and enter the battlefield alone. Now, it could only use one Lord's Avatar to fight Secret Master while the mechanical army rushed over.

Bang!

Streaks of blue magic energy with lightning-like trajectories blasted toward Han Xiao one after another, shattering on the shield of the Lord's Avatar.

Without the mechanical army by his side, his firepower was obviously insufficient. Han Xiao decided to use the floating cannon and charge through the barrage of spells. While Secret Master was unable to increase the distance between them, he uncharacteristically charged toward him.

After this Promotion, Han Technician's Strength and Agility attributes were already considered high among Beyond Grade As. His Lord's Avatar was facing a Mage alone, close combat was actually more advantageous than ranged combat.

One stood on the spot while the other approached rapidly. The distance between them quickly shortened.

In Han Xiao's vision, Secret Master's face was getting closer and closer.

"Eat my Fire Arrow Mallet!"

Activating his Critical Strike skill, Han Xiao charged forward.

Clang!

His metal forehead knocked against Secret Master's head through the Magic Shield.

Secret Master's head instantly buzzed, as though a bell was ringing in his brain. With a thought, all the runes and enchantments on his body lit up. Hundreds of Hands of Magic formed around him, throwing out a series of punches and fighting with Han Xiao.

As a Mage, it was very reasonable for him to light up his melee skill tree.

"What a strong force." Secret Master was secretly shocked that he was at a disadvantage in this exchange.

He had sparred with many Pugilists in the past. At this time, he discovered that the strength of Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar's melee attacks was even stronger than some Beyond Grade A Pugilists. He could not help but be shocked by Han Xiao's strength.

I keep feeling that Black Star is stronger than the rumors say …

This thought flashed through his mind. Secret Master focused his mind and multitasked. While dealing with Han Xiao's crazy close-range attacks, he controlled his magic to construct spell models and cast the mysticism spells that he was good at, specifically targeting luck.

Luck was originally ethereal, but at this moment, in Secret Master's vision, a blurry fog suddenly appeared around every life form. Some were thin, some were thick.

This was Secret Master's unique spell, which combined the principles of the soul, mind, foresight, divination, and many other aspects to successfully quantify the target's luck. The thickness of the fog represented the luck of a life form.

The better the luck, the thicker the fog, and the Luck Glow unique to protagonists was usually the thickest.

"Let me see how strong your luck is!"

Secret Master was determined to reduce Han Xiao's luck.

However, after taking a closer look, he was stunned!

Normally, Beyond Grade As were all people with strong luck. To be able to become a big shot in the universe, there was a limit to how bad one's luck could be. In his imagination, Black Star's luck should be so strong that his entire body should be covered in thick fog.

However, the real situation was the complete opposite … the fog around Black Star was so thin that it was almost transparent!

Secret Master had observed countless people, but this was the first time he had seen someone with such bad luck. He could not believe his eyes!

There was no way a Beyond Grade A's luck would be so bad!

Such an unlucky fellow actually managed to become a Beyond Grade A Super?

Secret Master was dumbfounded.

He had originally wanted to attack Black Star's luck, but now …

Was there still room for this guy's luck to decrease?

Many of Secret Master's unique spells indirectly caused huge soul damage by reducing the target's luck. However, against Han Xiao … he realized that his trump card seemed to be useless.

He lost his focus for an instant and revealed an opening. Han Xiao did not care about what he was thinking and took the opportunity to attack.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

The lightning-fast metal fists rapidly struck the thighs, infusing them with vibrating power.

Secret Master took a beating, and a few of the defensive runes on his body were shattered. Feeling pain all over his body, he did not dare be distracted anymore and took a defensive stance, barely holding on under Han Xiao's rapid attacks.

While the two of them were having a great time fighting, Ravenlaude, who was also trapped in the Void Prison, started hesitating.

Normally, Ravenlaude had to help his dynasty ally, but Black Star was also a competitor for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy …

Only by taking the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy back from Han Xiao can I complete the mission and exchange for the Universal Treasure.

After thinking about it, Ravenlaude made a decision and started casting spells to get rid of the effects of the Void Prison, dispelling this domain.

"Hmm?" Han Xiaoxin sensed something and gave Ravenlaude a death stare.

"Don't look at me. I'm just carrying out the dynasty's mission."

Ravenlaude sensed Han Xiao's gaze and replied before silently working together with Secret Master to dispel the Void Prison.

The next moment, the Void Prison domain was dispelled, and the surrounding space returned to normal. While the two of them were fighting, Ravenlaude activated a teleportation gate and disappeared, chasing after the mechanical army that was escorting the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy away.

Seeing this, Secret Master wanted to do the same, but the Lord's Avatar stuck to him and stalled him.

The mechanical army also arrived and activated the space stabilizer and Magic Disruptor. The effects covered this area and made the teleportation spell ineffective again, so Secret Master could not chase after him.

"Damn it!" Secret Master's face turned darker and darker. This situation meant that he was basically out of this battle.

Furthermore, Secret Master could tell that Black Star actually had a way to stop Ravenlaude but purposely let him go, leaving only him behind.

Is he targeting me?

Sh * t!

Seeing Secret Master's dark expression, Han Xiao chuckled. "You can tell that I purposely let Ravenlaude go? I'm not targeting you, I'm targeting him. "

He purposely let Ravenlaude have a chance to chase after him so that he could use Ravenlaude as a punching bag.

Because of the previous conflict, Han Xiao wanted to show more of his strength to the dynasty, but he did not want the outside world to know that he had grown again, in case the Mecha Empire came looking for him again. Therefore, he wanted to change the battlefield and eliminate as many bystanders as possible.

The dynasty's allies were the best targets.

Compared to fighting enemies, fighting teammates seemed to be more suitable for establishing dominance. After being beaten up, his teammates would still have to hide the battle information.

Although the Lord's Avatar was left behind to stall Secret Master, all the Apostle Weapons were in the escort team.

With such a configuration and the mechanical army, even if he was not present, he would still have enough combat power!

Splitting the troops and fighting on multiple fronts was the combat style of a Beyond Grade A Mechanic.
